title: Consolidated Access Review Playbook & SAML Audit Streamlining
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver a unified access review and audit-evidence flow that ties RBAC role snapshots, SCIM provisioning deltas, and SAML/SSO audit events into an automated periodic attestation process and evidence bundle for auditors. This ticket covers the engineering implementation for streaming SAML audit events, exporting role-graph snapshots, enabling delta SCIM exports for third-party identity providers, and wiring the outputs into the existing compliance evidence automation pipeline.

Why: Current compliance audits are manual: security teams run ad-hoc queries against the console, engineers export CSVs, and evidence assembly is error-prone. We must provide reproducible, tamper-evident artifacts that demonstrate who had access, when, and what changes occurred during the attestation window.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the UI attestation review flow (handled by PM ticket PM-421), nor does it include enterprise SSO onboarding UX (DES ticket will cover design). We own backend streaming, export formats, retention alignment, and API endpoints for the attestation orchestration service.
acceptance_criteria: A1: SAML/SSO events (login, logout, session-create, role-assert, attribute-changes) are published to the compliance Kafka topic with consistent JSON schema and versioning.
A2: A role-graph snapshot endpoint exists that returns role -> principal bindings for a requested epoch (ISO8601 timestamp) and supports paginated export.

A3: SCIM provisioning delta export endpoint implemented (since-last-timestamp) that lists add/replace/remove operations in canonical SCIM patch format and signs the payload with the infra signing key.

A4: Evidence bundles for a given attestation window can be generated: includes (a) role-graph snapshots, (b) SCIM delta sequence, (c) SAML audit stream slice, (d) retention-policy mapping JSON, and (e) a manifest file with hashes and signatures.
A5: Retention metadata for each artifact is recorded and enforced by the evidence pipeline (e.g., short-lived debug traces vs. 7-year audit artifacts).

A6: End-to-end tests covering one simulated attestation window pass in CI and a smoke test demonstrates an assembled evidence bundle uploaded to the compliance S3 bucket with immutable versioning enabled.
design_notes: Event pipeline: reuse existing Kafka cluster (topic: compliance.events.v1) with an Avro-compatible schema for event versioning. Use a lightweight envelope: {version, event_type, timestamp_utc, service, payload_hash, payload}.

SAML audit schema: event_type values: saml.session_start, saml.session_end, saml.attr_assert, saml.role_map, saml.idp_error. Include fields: request_id, user_id, saml_assertion_id, issuer, sp_entity_id, attributes_map, roles_asserted.

SCIM delta export: support query parameter since=<ISO8601>. Return list of objects with operation (add/replace/remove), path, value, actor_id, timestamp. Sign with current infra signing key (rotateable) and include key_id in manifest.

Role-graph snapshot: perform consistent read using leader read locking at epoch boundary. Export format: newline-delimited JSON with entries {role_id, role_name, members:[{principal_id, type, source}], created_at, source_origin}.

Evidence bundle: tar.gz of all artifacts + manifest.json. Manifest contains SHA256 for each file and a bundle_signature (ed25519) computed by compliance-key. Upload to s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/<customer>/<window>/bundle-<ts>.tar.gz and set object lock/retention per policy.

Retention mapping: map artifact types to tenant retention profiles (default: artifacts=7y, debug_traces=90d, session_logs=1y). Enforcement happens at upload time via S3 object lock tags and retention API calls.

comments: 2025-01-11: Initial scoping meeting with Security and PM. Identified requirement to sign evidence bundles for auditor verification.

2025-01-17: Spike results: sample SAML events published successfully to compliance.events.v1. Found inconsistent attribute naming from two Identity Providers — planned to canonicalize at producer layer.
2025-01-25: Design review with SRE and Infra. Agreed to reuse Kafka topic and add schema versioning. Need to coordinate schema registry migration window.
2025-02-05: Implemented prototype role-graph snapshot in staging. Discovered large tenants cause pagination hotspots; plan to add cursor-based pagination and snapshot partitioning by role namespace.
2025-02-12: Security notes: evidence bundle signing must support key rotation. Compliance recommends ed25519 with stored public keys in key registry and signed manifests including key_id.
2025-02-18: QA smoke test failing due to S3 object lock permissions. Raised infra ticket to add service principal to retention role.
risks: Large tenants: snapshots and SCIM deltas may be very large; need streaming export and pagination to avoid OOM/timeout in lambda workers.
Attribute normalization: inconsistent SAML attribute names across IdPs can cause false positives in attestation; canonicalization rules must be versioned and audited.
Retention enforcement: cloud object-lock misconfiguration could violate retention SLAs; require infra guardrails and pre-deployment checks.
Signing key management: key compromise risk; integrate HSM/KMS for signing keys and implement key rotation audit trail.
